claude.result:
`./game.html` is written — a single self-contained file (~2030 lines), no external resources, no browser storage, no `Math.random`.

**What's in it, against the priority list:**

| # | System | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Core loop | One `S` object, `mulberry32` seeded (default 1337, editable), 14-step documented resolution order in the header comment |
| 2 | Map | 8×8, 5 terrains from seed, generation guarantees a playable mix; terrain requirements + adjacency bonuses shown in tooltips with the exact multiplier and its source |
| 3 | Economy | Real chains: ore→metal (forge, eats power), ash→soil→food (composter→greenhouse, eats water), metal→parts (workshop). Caps enforced, overflow logged |
| 4 | Population | Named colonists, 4 jobs, skill 1–5 with slow growth, fatigue, morale; job mismatch = 55% of skill |
| 5 | Needs | Per-turn food/water, shortages drive morale; morale 0 = refuses to work, 3 turns at 0 = departure (gradual, recoverable) |
| 6 | Research | 12 nodes, prereq chains, locked/available/done, unlocks 3 buildings and multiplies 7 chain yields |
| 7 | Events | 15 events, 5 with 3-way choices, weighted deck, per-event cooldowns, all outcomes mutate state |
| 8 | Trade | Caravan every 6 turns for 3 turns, limited inventory and purse; price = base × mean-reverting global drift × your-stock scarcity × margin, fully broken down on hover |
| 9 | Hazard | Storms every 5 turns, severity scales with turn; integrity damage + water spike; windbreaks/shutters/relay mitigate (capped 60%); repairs cost parts + fatigue |
| 10 | Save/load | JSON to a textarea, field-by-field validation with specific error messages |
| 11 | End | Turn-60 win (pop ≥ 12 + needs met), pop-0 loss, itemised score screen |
| 12 | UI | 6 tabs, Space + 1–5/6 keys, tooltips on every number, 360px-friendly, state always carries a text label (`DMG`/`REFUSING`/`LOCKED`) not just colour |
| 13 | Dev | 38 assertions and a 200-turn greedy benchmark with a "run twice and compare hashes" button |

**One thing I could not do:** this environment gates code execution (`node --version` runs, but `node -e` and stdin evaluation both require approval that wasn't granted), so I could not run the test suite or benchmark myself. I reviewed the logic statically and fixed six defects that pass caught on re-read — a save textarea wiped by re-render, `clinic`/`relay` failing the building-coherence assertion, a storm test that compared unequal building counts, two famine tests that population-adding events could pollute, and a skill tooltip reading `undefined` at level 5. The suite's own results are one click away in the Dev panel; if anything is red there, tell me the assertion name and I'll fix it.
